blocks.heading: Where are we?
blocks.text: You can find us located on the second floor at EMAGC Room 2.312

blocks.heading: How can I Join?
blocks.text:
To register, sign up on our V-Link and fill out the Membership Contract. Submit the contract by email to [msoc@msocutrgv.com](mailto:msoc@msocutrgv.com), or deliver it in person to EMAGC Room 2.312 if a Mathematical Society Member is present.

If you wish to be an **Active Member**, you may also send the $20 membership fee to the Cash App on the CashApp Flyer, or pay in cash when you deliver your contract in person. The Membership Flyer explains what each membership includes.

Once you register, your email will be added to our Teams Chat so you get announcements.
